Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: In the final “Updated Understanding,” the Planner swapped the directors’ birth years—assigning 1898 to Georges Méliès and 1861 to James Tinling—contradicting the gathered sources (Méliès: 1861; Tinling: 1889 per Wikipedia or 1898 per IMDb). This data mix-up led to the incorrect conclusion that Christ Walking on the Water had the later-born director, when it should have been 45 Fathers.
